List the Installed Plugins

Source: R/plugin_manifest.R
episodic_plugin_list.Rd

Lists every plugin in the plugin folder and every plugin the configuration enables, with its status and, when it cannot run, why. See vignette("plugins").

Usage

episodic_plugin_list(
  episodic_config_path = Sys.getenv("EPISODIC_CONFIG", unset = NA)
)

Arguments

episodic_config_path

The configuration file. Defaults to the EPISODIC_CONFIG environment variable.

Value

A data frame with one row per plugin: id, name, version, trigger, placement, status ("enabled", "disabled", "needs_approval", "unavailable" or "missing"), permissions, secrets, destination and problems (the reasons, as text in the EPISODIC_LANGUAGE language, separated by "; ").

Details

The plugin folder is EPISODIC_PLUGIN_DIR, or a plugins folder beside the configuration file (EPISODIC_CONFIG) when that is unset.

See also

episodic_plugin_install(), episodic_plugin_enable(), episodic_plugin_run(), vignette("plugins")

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
episodic_plugin_list()
} # }
